newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W. Europe paper, board and pulp output down in Q2.
newsitem.headline: W. Europe paper, board and pulp output down in Q2.

text.p: Production of paper, board and pulp continued to fall in western Europe in the second quarter of 1996 compared with the same period in 1995, the Confederation of European Paper Industries (CEPI) said on Monday.
"For the third consecutive quarter total production of paper and board was below the respective level of the previous year," it said in a publication on second quarter statistics.

After a decline of 9.5 percent in the fourth quarter of 1995, and of six percent in the first quarter this year, output in the second quarter declined 7.6 percent year-on-year to 17.7 million tonnes and was 1.5 percent lower than in the same period of 1994.
Production of pulp fell by over one million tonnes, 12.2 percent, during the quarter.
Production fell especially for graphic grades.
"...production of most paper and board grades, as well as pulp grades, decreased in the second quarter again when compared to the second quarter 1995," it said.
The statistics included the European Union as well as Switzerland and Norway.
